name: Arganil / Piódão wildfire, 13–24 August 2025
description: Largest burned area on record in Portugal. Started by dry lightning above Piódão (Arganil) and spread into Seia, Covilhã, Fundão and Castelo Branco.
ignition_basis: Piódão village coordinates; reports place the start on the slope above the village around 05:00 local (approximate).

elevation_source.name: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen / AWS Open Data), zoom 11, bilinear to 200 m
elevation_source.licence: Open data; attribution to Mapzen and sources (SRTM, EU-DEM, …)

vegetation.note: Altitudinal zonation assumption for the Serra do Açor / Estrela slopes (OSM land cover unavailable): high pasture and rock above 1500 m, shrubland (mato, much of it regrowth after the 2017 fires) 800–1500 m, maritime pine 400–800 m, eucalyptus below 400 m. Replace with COS/OSM land cover when available.

weather_source.name: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo historical weather API (9 points)

events.title: Fogo começa na encosta acima do Piódão (cerca das 05:00)
events.detail: Local officials attribute the fire to a dry-lightning strike during the night; strong wind spread embers.

facts.cause: trovoada seca (dry lightning), per local officials

events.title: Alerta às 05:08 (ANEPC)
events.detail: Civil protection records the alert at 05:08 local time.

events.title: Trovoada seca provocou fogo em Arganil junto à aldeia do Piódão
events.detail: More than 300 personnel deployed on the first day.

events.title: Análise: vento de sudeste empurra o fogo para noroeste
events.detail: Portal Bombeiros.pt analysis (IPMA/ANEPC data): south-easterly wind pushing the fire north-west, turning west/north-west late afternoon, gusts above 40 km/h.

events.title: 890 operacionais; Piódão cercado pelas chamas
events.detail: Flames spread to neighbouring municipalities; evacuations including Foz d'Égua and Chãs d'Égua.

events.title: Frente ativa em Seia, no Parque Natural da Serra da Estrela
events.detail: Active front by the stream between Teixeira and Teixeira de Baixo; evacuated residents allowed back from 12:00.

events.title: Fogo descontrolado: ventos variáveis e rajadas desde a tarde de domingo
events.detail: Arganil mayor: fire completely out of control with shifting winds and gusts from late afternoon and night of Sunday 17 August; reaches the Serra da Estrela park boundary.

events.title: Covilhã: "incêndio fora de controlo"; três frentes no Fundão
events.detail: Fronts at Silvares, around Lavacolhos, and the most devastating one heading to Enxabarda; Covilhã asks residents to stay in safe places.

events.title: Fogo entra no concelho de Castelo Branco vindo do Fundão
events.detail: Covilhã considers the fire out of control because of wind intensity, with gusts reaching 40 km/h.
